sources: Esri World_Imagery with the rec.gov per-site points

values.note: 42 sites in 3 loops: 23 reservable, 19 first-come. FS: 'Maximum spur length is 60 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.' The recreation.gov catalog lists 20-60 ft (most 40-50 ft; one 20-ft site) with 12 pull-throughs. Single sites hold 6 people and 1 vehicle (up to 8 and 2 for $10/night each extra).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/big-meadows-campground-and-picnic-area ('This 42 site campground meanders up a mountainside above Big Meadows Reservoir in a series of 3 loops. 23 of the sites are reservable through Recreation.gov, while the remaining 19 sites are first come, first served'; 'Maximum spur length is 60 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.') + recreation.gov per-site catalog for 232252 (Max Vehicle Length 20-60, 12 Pull-Through) + notice 'All single campsite reservation fees are good for 6 people and 1 vehicle ...', read 2026-10-28

Please fill your trailer prior to arriving.'; 'Electric hookups are not available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water in the peak season only; trailers may not fill at the hydrants. Nearest dump station 13 miles away at the Rainbow Grocery in South Fork. Trash service Memorial Day to Labor Day only.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/big-meadows-campground-and-picnic-area ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Drinking water is available.'; 'The nearest dump station is 13 miles away at the Rainbow Grocery in South Fork, CO.'; 'Trash service is provided by the concessionaire from Memorial Day to Labor Day') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232252 (amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)'; 'Trailers are not allowed to fill at any hydrants'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Concessionaire season Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend (2026 operations began May 22). Off-season, 6 first-come sites remain usable with no water, trash or host at $10/night.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/big-meadows-campground-and-picnic-area ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day Weekend.'; Current Conditions: 'Concessionaire operations for the 2026 season will begin May 22nd ... values.note: 23 sites reservable on recreation.gov or 877-444-6777, at least 4 days ahead and up to 6 months out (12 months for the group area); 19 first-come. A reservation not occupied by check-out time the day after arrival is released to first-come campers. 14-night limit in any 30 days. Check-in after 2 p.m., check-out before 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/big-meadows-campground-and-picnic-area ('Reservations must be made at least 4 days ahead of arrival and can be made up to 6 months in advance for standard sites or 12 months in advance for group areas'; '14-day camping limit'; 'Check in time is after 2:00 pm. Check out time is before 11:00 am.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232252 (rules minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 4; 2026 Peak Season rate period 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07; notice on reservations held until check-out the day after arrival), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Single site $29/night, double $58, group $99; extra person past 6 or 2nd vehicle $10/night. Shoulder season $10/night for a single or double site. Same rates on recreation.gov for 2027. Cash or check on site.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/big-meadows-campground-and-picnic-area ('Single Site: $29 per night / Double Site: $58 per night / Group Site: $99 per night / Single or Double Site: $10 per night (during shoulder season)'; 'Please be prepared to pay with cash or check.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232252/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: RV/standard non-electric $29, double $58, group tent $99), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Interagency Senior/Access passes: 50% off single campsites only, and only the site the pass holder occupies.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/big-meadows-campground-and-picnic-area ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Rio Grande NF (Divide RD), run by a concessionaire; ~11 mi W of South Fork, 1.8 mi off US-160 on FR 410 (passenger-car access), ~9,500 ft, in 3 loops up the lightly wooded hillside above Big Meadows Reservoir, not on the shore. Boat ramp and accessible fishing pier on the reservoir's north shore. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 232252: confirmed 42 sites (23 reservable / 19 FCFS), max spur 60 ft (the FS page's own figure, not a placeholder), no electric or water hookups, vault toilets, drinking water, $29 (2027 same), 14-night limit. Added pull-throughs, dump false (nearest 13 mi), weekend 2 / holiday 3 minimums, 4-day cutoff, 6-month window, booking.season 05-22..09-07, season as a note (Memorial Day-Labor Day; 6 off-season FCFS sites at $10), senior/access 50% discount. Note cleaned.

Pin 37.53808,-106.79650 is 36 m from the centroid of the 47 catalogued site points (37.53792,-106.79686). OK.
